描述_EN: fragmentary square of red tapestry with geometric decoration that had been added by sewing to the set to which it belonged. The central space of the square is occupied by a stylized rhombus in reserve, embellished at all four points with small spikes, a kind of stylized leaf. the room's frame is composed of a two-tone green and ecru band.
描述_ZN: 零碎的方形红色挂毯，带有几何装饰，是通过缝制加入到它所属的套装中。 正方形的中央空间被一个保留的菱形所占据，菱形的四个点上点缀着小钉子，是一种造型的叶子。 作品的框架是由绿色和赤褐色的双色带组成。
时期: 埃及 拜占庭统治时期
